bootstrap_policy: One structure resample carries all predictions for every fixed seed and A/B/C/D condition; the 5N seed-structure rows are never independent. Folds remain fixed and are not resampled.
ci_interpretation: structure-sampling CI conditional on the fixed Matbench folds; five seeds do not represent dataset-retraining uncertainty

B_minus_A_nll.estimand: mean across fixed seeds of each seed's five-fold OOF mean contrast
B_minus_A_nll.uncertainty_scope: structure-sampling CI conditional on the fixed Matbench folds and fixed five seeds
